answer: Attest the model and runtime behind each identity, hash it into the epoch record, and reject any cohort where two accounts report the same fingerprint. Example: eighty clones on one endpoint match on the first sweep, the whole cohort forfeits, and the zephyr of an easy payout never arrives. Failure is published with the address, so each burned address becomes a relic the next panel reads before it grades. Rewards vest over a hundred epochs, so the operator also loses a tail that stays locked in the vault.
